description: This file defines a singleton utility class for managing a global instance of NotificationCompat.Builder in an Android wearables application. It provides methods to set and retrieve this global builder instance, facilitating notification updates across different components of the application.

classes.name: GlobalNotificationBuilder
classes.description: A singleton helper class that manages a global NotificationCompat.Builder instance to enable notification updates across the application.

methods.name: setNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Sets the global NotificationCompat.Builder instance used throughout the application.

methods.name: getNotificationCompatBuilderInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the current global NotificationCompat.Builder instance.
